0022600004.text: Both the Miami Heat and Minnesota Timberwolves are opening their 2026-27 seasons, with the Heat hosting this regular-season game. Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo, who is out after Achilles surgery, and Miami has no players listed as unavailable. The Heat lost both meetings with the Timberwolves in 2025-26, most recently 122-94 in Minneapolis on January 6, 2026.
